Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped in the right lane of the frontbound feeder road near Katy, Texas, when the vehicle behind them,
operated by Driver 2, struck the rear bumper. Driver 1 advised that the impact pushed their vehicle forward a short
distance before it came to rest. A Passegner was also in the vehicle, though the Passenger's exact seating position at
the moment of impact could not be fully established during the interview. Driver 1 reported low back pain and stiffness
and was offered medical evaluation at the scene, which was declined at that time. Damage to the rear of Driver 1's
vehicle is consistent with the reported impact, and no prior damage to the vehicle was known to Driver 1 or observed
by the responding officer. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy involved. No independent witnesses
were located, no photographs of the scene were provided, and no other crash report was on file for the location at the
time of this review. Driver 2 was ctied for following too closely.
